governing_thought: Arts and literature is divided by the feature of the work a claim is about, running outward from the material object to judgment: medium and making, form, meaning, context and reception, and value.
dimension: what feature of the work the sentence is about
rank_note: The pillars run from the material object outward to judgment of the work.

pillars.title: Medium and making
pillars.statement: Medium and making is the feature of a work concerned with the material, technique and process by which it is produced.

pillars.title: Form
pillars.statement: Form is the feature of a work concerned with its design, structure, genre and style as it appears to the audience.

pillars.title: Meaning
pillars.statement: Meaning is the feature of a work concerned with what it represents, expresses and conveys through ideas and theory.

pillars.title: Context and reception
pillars.statement: Context and reception is the feature of a work concerned with the place, language, time, industry and audience in which it is produced and received.

pillars.title: Value
pillars.statement: Value is the feature of a work concerned with how it is judged, studied historically and assigned standing within culture.

method_line.title: Method line
method_line.covers: how the discipline is studied, taught and recorded
